description:
Required Skills: 

 
 
 Ø Install, configure and upgrade Microsoft Dynamics CRM 
 
 
 Ø Administer, monitor, support, and performance tune customized Microsoft Dynamics CRM installations 
 
 
 Ø Map functional system requirements to Dynamics CRM capabilities and design appropriate solutions. 
 
 
 Ø Configure entities and associated forms, views, and business rules in Dynamics CRM, including advanced validation of form data using Script, 
 
 
 Ø Configure call outs to CRM API and custom Microsoft.NET assemblies, and CRM ploug-ins. 
 
 
 Ø Create and modify Dynamics CRM workflows/processes 
 
 
 Ø Create and modify SQL Reporting Services reports for use inside and outside of Dynamics CRM. 
 
 
 Ø Create and modify dynamics CRM extensions to interface with other systems via message queues and web services 
 
 
 Ø Import data from other systems into Dynamics CRM 
 
 
 Ø Porting of CRM solutions between different environments.
